stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np, json
def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape; cs=comps_of(g)
    regs=regs_cc(g)
    res=g.copy()
    for (r0,c0,reg) in regs:
        if len(reg)==1: continue   # leave stray single cells
        # collect all nonzero components 8-adjacent (incl diag) to region
        near=[t for t in cs if any(abs(t['r0']-y)<=1 and abs(t['c0']-x)<=1 for y,x in reg)]
        if not near: continue      # no seed -> skip (leave as-is)
        cells=[(y,x,v) for t in near for y in range(t['r0'],t['r0']+t['h']) for x in range(t['c0'],t['c0']+t['w']) for v in [t['sub'][y-t['r0']][x-t['c0']]] if int(v)!=0]
        rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs2=[p[1] for p in cells]
        tb=[[int(v) for v in row] for row in g[min(rs):max(rs)+1,min(cs2):max(cs2)+1]]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs2)-min(cs2)+1
        for y,x in reg:
            res[y,x]=tb[(y-r0)%h][(x-c0)%w]
    return [[int(v) for v in row] for row in res]

for name in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2'):
